PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Cora's clue ("She was in the Warehouse, but not beside the barrel. She was in a corner of her area."). So Cora (C) must be at row 1, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: The murderer must be in Vivian's area without sharing her row or column; that rules out squares for Vivian. Using the general clue ("There was exactly one person sitting in a chair."), some squares are ruled out for Arlo. So Arlo (A) must be at row 2, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Cora and Arlo crossed out, only one square is left for Douglas that fits his clue ("He was beside the sack."). So Douglas (D) must be at row 4, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Esme is now the only person who can still go in row 6. So Esme (E) must be at row 6, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Brenda that fits her clue ("She was with Cora."). So Brenda (B) must be at row 3, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vivian. So Vivian (the victim) must be at row 5, column 2. Cross out her row and column. Esme is the only person in the Shipyard with Vivian, so Esme is the murderer!
